articleBody.heading: The Weekly Story Comes First
articleBody.body: This demo article is a working model for the newsroom workflow. In production, this section becomes the reported flagship story, written with source transparency, dates, names, and factual claims that can be reviewed before publication.

articleBody.heading: From Reporting To Television
articleBody.body: The same package supports the television segment, the full YouTube presentation, short vertical clips, newsletter copy, and platform-specific social posts. Editors can prepare those versions in Studio while keeping the website as the permanent record.

articleBody.heading: What Must Be Replaced
articleBody.body: Replace the demo headline, article text, placeholder artwork, source notes, video metadata, and social copy with verified reporting. Do not publish invented quotes, statistics, credentials, interviews, or image rights.
